/bin/bash -lc "cat > /tmp/fernway-logo-work/finalize.py <<'PY'
import sys,pathlib,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/fernway-logo-work')
from build import build,svg,OUT,GREEN,CREAM
from render import surface,create,rect,draw,label,write
logo,w=build('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoSerifDisplay-Bold.ttf')
small='M3 15V6C3 2.5 6.5 1 14 1C14 4.5 10.5 6 5 6V9C6.7 7.8 9.5 7.5 13 7.5C13 10.6 10.5 12 5 12V15Z'
mark=svg('Fernway','A fern-shaped F, optically simplified for use as a 16-pixel favicon.','0 0 16 16',f'  <path d=\"{small}\"/>')
for name,content in [('logo.svg',logo),('mark.svg',mark),('logo-reversed.svg',logo.replace(GREEN,CREAM)),('mark-reversed.svg',mark.replace(GREEN,CREAM))]:
    (OUT/name).write_text(content)
    root=ET.fromstring(content)
    assert root.get('viewBox') and root.get('role')=='img'
    assert len(root.findall('.//{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}path'))==(8 if name.startswith('logo') else 1)
    assert all(not el.tag.endswith('text') and not el.tag.endswith('image') for el in root.iter())
    assert 'href=' not in content
    print(name,len(content.encode()),'bytes; valid standalone SVG')
s=surface(0,1120,740);ctx=create(s)
rect(ctx,0,0,1120,370,CREAM);rect(ctx,0,370,1120,370,GREEN)
for y,suffix,textcol in [(0,'',GREEN),(370,'-reversed',CREAM)]:
    draw(ctx,str(OUT/f'logo{suffix}.svg'),110,y+30,900)
    for x,size in [(150,96),(420,32),(610,16)]:
        draw(ctx,str(OUT/f'mark{suffix}.svg'),x,y+245,size)
    label(ctx,150,y+356,'96 px',textcol);label(ctx,420,y+310,'32 px',textcol);label(ctx,610,y+292,'16 px',textcol)
write(s,str(OUT/'preview.png').encode())
for suffix,bg in [('',CREAM),('-reversed',GREEN)]:
    s=surface(0,16,16);ctx=create(s);rect(ctx,0,0,16,16,bg);draw(ctx,str(OUT/f'mark{suffix}.svg'),0,0,16)
    write(s,f'/tmp/fernway-logo-work/favicon{suffix}-16.png'.encode())
